name: voice-grill
description: A voice-first interviewer in the spirit of grill-me / grilling. Just talk through voice input (Aqua Voice and similar); it asks up to 5 numbered questions per round to draw out and sharpen your thinking, then writes the article or plans and executes the work. Replies in your language.

interface.shortDescription: A voice-first interviewer in the spirit of grill-me / grilling
interface.longDescription: Talk freely through voice input (Aqua Voice and similar) and it interviews you with up to 5 numbered questions per round. Unlike grill-me / grilling, which asks one question at a time, it sorts long spoken answers that cover several questions at once, so it takes far fewer round trips. Once you agree on the summary, it either plans and executes the work, or writes an article using only the interview notes as material. Replies in your language.
defaultPrompt: Interview me. I'll just talk through what I'm thinking.
Interview me and turn it into a blog post
